name: Keld
description: A land onto which Skyshroud was transplanted; Radha seeks to become a true Keldon here.

description_citations.text: "Time Spiral (novel)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Starke recalls how Maraxus forced him to help take Sisay prisoner, yet Volrath and Maraxus still refused to free him or his daughter.
timeline.quote: He had gained nothing by betraying Sisay

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Greel slays Rayne in the final battle of the Prophecy War, and Barrin in rage destroys the Keldon army, Greel and the overlord Latulla.
timeline.quote: Rayne was slain by Greel

citation.text: "Barrin", section "The Prophecy War in Jamuraa". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gatha experiments with splicing Phyrexian DNA into test subjects and is expelled, continuing in Keld.
timeline.quote: While he was found out and expelled, he continued his project in Keld .

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Gatha's Research". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kreig seizes power in Keld with Gatha at his side; Croag starts a war to retrieve the research, and Gatha and Kreig jump off a cliff to keep their knowledge from Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Gatha and Kreig jumped off a cliff to keep their knowledge and genetic potential out of Phyrexia's reach

citation.text: "Bloodline Project", section "Gatha's Research". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel at Keld and takes her unconscious.
timeline.quote: Jeska defeats Radha in a duel and takes the unconscious elf with her.

citation.text: "Future Sight (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The original Keldons come from Parma under Kradak to escape the cold.
timeline.quote: The original Keldons came over from Parma led by Kradak to escape the deadly cold of that land.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Founding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Keld is founded by the union of fire and hearth through Kradak's pact with Jezal.
timeline.quote: Thus Keld was founded by the union of fire and hearth.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Founding". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gatha's experiments transform Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest being Kreig.
timeline.quote: His experiments transformed the Keldons into nightmarish warriors, the mightiest of which was the witch-king Kreig .

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gatha throws himself off a cliff rather than let the Phyrexians learn his secrets.
timeline.quote: The researcher threw himself off a cliff to prevent the Phyrexians from discovering his secrets.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kreig injures the Phyrexian general and leaps off the same cliff.
timeline.quote: Inspired by his friend's heroic sacrifice, Kreig grievously injured the Phyrexian general before tossing himself off the same cliff in defiance of his foe.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: True-blooded Keldons regain the Doyen Council and make war on the Gathans.
timeline.quote: The true-blooded Keldons regained control of the Doyen Council and made war on the Gathans.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Rise and Fall of Gatha". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Keldons launch the Prophecy War, invading Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: A few months before the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria, the Keldons launched their invasion of Jamuraa.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Barrin defeat and destroy Latulla's banished followers in Jamuraa.
timeline.quote: were eventually defeated and destroyed by the planeswalker Teferi and Barrin the Master Wizard.

citation.text: "Keld", section "Prophecy War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eladamri makes peace with Warlord Astor as Skyshroud overlays Keld.
timeline.quote: Skyshroud forest overlayed in Keld and Eladamri the Elflord made peace with Warlord Astor of Keld.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian necromancy raises the Keldon honored dead during the battle on the frozen lake.
timeline.quote: In the heat of battle, the Keldon honored dead were raised from their graves not by Twilight, but by Phyrexian necromancy.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tajamin shatters the frozen lake with her sacred cudgel, sinking most of both armies.
timeline.quote: In this time of greatest atrocity, Doyenne Tajamin cast her sacred cudgel into the frozen lake, shattering it into a thousand pieces.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Golden Argosy carries surviving Keldons to Urborg for the final battle against Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: The Argosy then bore them off to Urborg where they fought in the final battle of the Invasion against Yawgmoth and his forces.

citation.text: "Keld", section "The Keldon Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Teferi's help Radha defeats the Gathan Doyen Greht.
timeline.quote: With the help of Teferi , she became a great warlord in her own right and was able to defeat the Gathan Doyen Greht.

citation.text: "Keld", section "After Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise's sacrifice and the Skyshroud's destruction heal Keld's rift.
timeline.quote: With the sacrifice of the planeswalker Freyalise and the destruction of the Skyshroud forest, Keld's rift was finally healed allowing the nation to start the long road back to recovery and prosperity.

citation.text: "Keld", section "After Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha abolishes the taking of slaves as plunder.
timeline.quote: The taking of slaves as plunder has been abolished, and Keldons now learn industries and crafts.

citation.text: "Keld", section "After Twilight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A peace summit at Oyster Bay between Radha's Keldons and Aron Capashen's Benalish is interrupted by Karn and Teferi's warning and revealed Phyrexian sleeper agents.
timeline.quote: The summit was interrupted when the planeswalkers Karn and Teferi revealed the threat of a New Phyrexian invasion and several of the Benalish knights turned out to be Phyrexian sleeper agents .

citation.text: "Keld", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gatha's unauthorized experiments lead to his expulsion; he continues in Keld, creating Kreig, which Phyrexia notices.
timeline.quote: he continued his project in Keld , ultimately creating Kreig , which was powerful enough to get noticed by Phyrexia.

citation.text: "Metathran", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Keld fallen Keldon heroes return fighting for Phyrexia; Tajamin melts the glacier, drowning Phyrexians, and the Golden Argosy saves most Keldons and elves and carries them to Urborg.
timeline.quote: Doyenne Tajamin uses her holy cudgel to melt the entire glacier on which the battle is being fought.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha aids Teferi against the time rifts and drives the Gathans from Keld.
timeline.quote: She aided the planeswalker Teferi during his attempts to save Dominaria from the time rifts

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jeska asks Radha for help, Radha refuses, and Jeska wins their fight using her latent Phage powers.
timeline.quote: Radha refused, and the two barbarian women fought.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha claims her Keldon heritage on the Mountain, retrieves Astor's daggers and leads the new nation of Keld; her planeswalker spark is permanently extinguished.
timeline.quote: thus she will never be able to ascend.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha defeats the last Gathan warlord and becomes Grand Warlord of Keld.
timeline.quote: Radha defeated the last Gathan warlord and became the Grand Warlord of Keld.

citation.text: "Radha", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha is captured by the Cabal and forced to fight in the Stronghold's pit; Gideon Jura's arrival lets her escape, and she kills Whisper.
timeline.quote: During the escape, she ended up killing Whisper .

citation.text: "Radha", section "Fighting the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha helps Gideon and Chandra find the Blackblade and organizes the spirits of Urborg against the Cabal.
timeline.quote: and organized the spirits of Urborg in their attack on the Cabal .

citation.text: "Radha", section "Fighting the Cabal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha fights in defense of Dominaria during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: Radha fought in defense of Dominaria during the

citation.text: "Radha", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Skyshroud arrives on the frozen wastes of Keld and Freyalise casts a spell to keep it warm.
timeline.quote: it was saved by the planeswalker Freyalise , who cast a spell to keep the forest warm.

citation.text: "Skyshroud Forest", section "Planeshifted to Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Rathi Overlay, Freyalise overlays the Skyshroud Forest into Keld, opening another rift.
timeline.quote: Freyalise overlaid the Skyshroud Forest into Keld , opening yet another rift

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Causes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise sacrifices her life and destroys Skyshroud to seal the Keld rift.
timeline.quote: sacrificed her life and destroyed the forest she had once saved

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Keld conquers Askaranton.
timeline.quote: conquered by Keld

citation.text: "The Domains", section "Locations in the Domains". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freyalise places the Skyshroud Forest by brute force, causing the Skyshroud rift to drain green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld.
timeline.quote: causing the Skyshroud rift to drain the green and red mana from Skyshroud and Keld

citation.text: "Time Spiral", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Radha defeats the Gathan warlord and becomes the new Warlord of Keld, shifting her rift connection to Keld.
timeline.quote: she becomes the new Warlord of Keld

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
